 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32

[red bold]-- TASK ERROR -- main.volt:6[/red bold]

Critical task `t` calls `sleep()` which is not safe in ISR context (hardware timer interrupt).

 [dim]5 |[/dim]         led.toggle()
 [dim]6 |[/dim]         sleep(10ms)
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Remove `sleep()` from this task, or remove `strict` to make it a Background task.[/cyan]
